defsZh:
n. 墊子, 橡皮軟墊
vt. 加墊褥, 緩衝, 掩蓋
defsEn: a mechanical damper; absorbs energy of sudden impulses

defsZh:
n. 劑量, 服用量
vt. 給藥, (用藥)醫治
vi. 服藥
defsEn: a measured portion of medicine taken at any one time

defsZh:
n. 鼓, 鼓聲
vi. 擊鼓, 作鼓聲
vt. 打鼓奏出
[計] 磁鼓

examples.zh: 鼓聲漸漸地消失。
她會打鼓。
湯姆會打邦哥鼓。

defsEn: a musical percussion instrument; usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end

defsZh:
vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留腦中
[計] 嵌入

examples.en: The scene was embedded in his memory.
Ivan had a chip embedded in his skin.
A knife was embedded in Layla's chest.

defsEn: fix or set securely or deeply

defsZh: v. 疏散, 撤出, 排洩

examples.en: People were evacuated because of the flood.
examples.zh: 人們因為洪水被疏散了。

examples.en: The people were evacuated because of the flood.
examples.zh: 人們因為洪水被疏散了。

examples.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
examples.zh: 我們有不到五分鐘來疏散整棟樓的人。

defsEn: move out of an unsafe location into safety

defsZh:
vt. 加快, 促進, 發出
a. 暢通的, 無阻礙的, 迅速的, 方便的

examples.en: We're trying to expedite the process.
Would you like to expedite this order?

defsEn: speed up the progress of; facilitate

defsZh:
n. 熄滅者, 滅火器, 消滅者
[化] 滅火器; 滅火劑

examples.en: Tom used a fire extinguisher to try and put the fire out.
examples.zh: 湯姆試著用滅火器把火撲滅。

defsEn: a manually operated device for extinguishing small fires

defsZh: n. 熟悉, 精通, 親密

examples.en: Love's intensity can wane as familiarity grows.

defsEn: personal knowledge or information about someone or something

defsZh:
n. 缺點, 裂紋, 瑕疵, 一陣狂風
[化] 劃痕; 裂縫; 裂紋

examples.zh: 設計本身有問題。

examples.en: Although she has flaws, I still like her.
examples.zh: 雖然她有缺點，但我喜歡她。

examples.en: I can't find a single flaw in his theory.
examples.zh: 我在他的理論中找不到任何問題。

defsEn: an imperfection in an object or machine

defsZh:
vi. 變動, 起伏, 動搖
vt. 使波動, 使動搖

examples.en: The price of gold fluctuates daily.
examples.zh: 黃金的價格每天波動。

examples.en: The policy fluctuated between two opinions.
examples.zh: 該政策在兩種意見之間搖擺。

defsEn: cause to fluctuate or move in a wavelike pattern

defsZh: a. 流利的, 流暢的

examples.zh: 他說法語說得很流利。
他能說流利的中文。
他能講流利的日語。

defsEn: smooth and unconstrained in movement

defsZh: adv. 真誠地, 公正地

examples.zh: 說實在的，我真的喜歡你。

examples.en: Honestly, I also want to learn Japanese.
examples.zh: 其實我也想學日語。

examples.en: I may look strong, but I'm honestly not.
examples.zh: 我看上去像是很有力氣的人，可實際上並非如此。

defsEn: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that

defsZh: vi. 自立門戶, 主持家務
defsEn: maintain a household; take care of all business related to a household

defsZh: n. 颶風, 暴風, 暴風雨

examples.en: After the hurricane, their house was a wreck.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，他們的房子成了廢墟。

defsEn: a severe tropical cyclone usually with heavy rains and winds moving a 73-136 knots (12 on the Beaufort scale)

defsZh:
n. 衛生保健, 衛生學, 保健法
[醫] 衛生, 衛生學

defsZh:
n. 整體, 積分, 整數
a. 固有的, 整體的, 整數的, 積分的
[計] 積分

examples.en: Death is an integral part of life.
Taiwan is an integral part of China.
Fluence is the time integral of flux.

defsEn: the result of a mathematical integration; F(x) is the integral of f(x) if dF/dx = f(x)

defsZh:
a. 相互作用的, 相互影響的
[計] 互動, 人機對話的

examples.en: Our course uses an interactive method.

defsEn: used especially of drugs or muscles that work together so the total effect is greater than the sum of the two (or more)

defsZh:
vi. 妨礙, 衝突, 干涉, 牴觸
[醫] 干擾, 干涉, 阻礙, 碰腿(馬)

examples.en: I had no right to interfere.
examples.zh: 我沒有權利干涉。
湯姆不會干涉你的。
不要插手我的事。

defsEn: come between so as to be hindrance or obstacle

defsZh:
n. 千克, 公斤
[醫] 千克, 公斤

examples.zh: 我瘦了三公斤。
你達到 60 公斤重了嗎？

examples.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
examples.zh: 米以公斤為單位來出售。

defsEn: one thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

defsZh: n. 臨時解僱, 操作停止, 活動停止期間

examples.en: The company announced hundreds of layoffs.
The scuttlebutt is that layoffs are coming.
Fortunately, the organizational changes did not involve any layoffs.

defsEn: the act of laying off an employee or a work force

defsZh:
n. 不到平均重量的人/物, 輕量級, 無足輕重的人, 性格不夠強的人
a. 平均重量以下的, 重量輕的
[計] 輕便的, 輕量的
defsEn: a professional boxer who weighs between 131 and 135 pounds

defsZh:
n. 優點, 功績, 價值, 功過, 真相
vt. 值得
vi. 應受

examples.en: With all her merits she was not proud.
examples.zh: 她不自豪她所有的優點。

examples.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.
examples.zh: 魅力衝擊視覺，美德征服心靈。

defsEn: any admirable quality or attribute

defsZh: n. 項鍊

examples.en: My nan gave me this necklace.
examples.zh: 這條項鍊是我奶奶送給我的。

examples.en: My grandma gave me this necklace.
examples.zh: 這條項鍊是我奶奶送給我的。

examples.en: Tom found Mary's necklace under the sofa.
examples.zh: 在沙發下，湯姆找到了瑪麗的項鍊。

defsEn: jewelry consisting of a cord or chain (often bearing gems) worn about the neck as an ornament (especially by women)

defsZh: a. 貧窮的, 貧困的, 生活艱苦的

defsZh:
vt. 多付, 多給報酬
vi. 付得過多
defsEn: pay too much

defsZh: n. 小冊子, 活頁文選

examples.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.
examples.zh: 這本小冊子是免費的。

defsEn: a small book usually having a paper cover

defsZh:
a. 部分的, 偏袒的, 偏愛的
n. 分音

examples.en: It was only a partial success.
examples.zh: 那只是部分的成功。

examples.en: Departure is a partial death but death in essence is not only departure.
examples.zh: 離開是部分的死亡，而死亡不僅僅是離開。

defsZh:
vt. 處刑, 對...處罰(刑), 使不利
[法] 處罰, 對...處以刑事懲罰

examples.en: Tom could be penalized for that.

defsEn: impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on

defsZh:
vt. 汙染, 弄髒, 玷汙
[化] 汙染

examples.en: This water was polluted by oil.
examples.zh: 這水被石油汙染了。
廢水經常汙染海洋。

examples.en: The air was polluted by exhaust gas.
examples.zh: 空氣被廢氣汙染了。

defsEn: make impure

defsZh: v. 規定, 指定, 囑咐, 開處方

examples.en: Let's see what fate has prescribed.
examples.zh: 看緣分吧。

examples.en: The doctor has prescribed you medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生給您開了藥。

examples.en: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生給他的病人開了一些藥。

defsEn: issue commands or orders for

defsZh:
a. 很可能的, 大概的, 可信的
n. 很有希望的候選人, 很可能的事情

examples.en: When will the most probable hypothetical accident occur?
examples.zh: 最大可能假想事故什麼時候會發生？

examples.en: It is highly probable that the deletion of element C will still yield the same result.
examples.zh: 很有可能去掉C元素會得出同樣的結果。

examples.en: It is probable that he is ill.

defsEn: an applicant likely to be chosen

defsZh: a. 卓越的, 顯著的, 突出的, 凸出的

examples.zh: 知名文學界人士昨晚齊聚一堂。

examples.en: He's famous as a prominent pianist.

defsEn: having a quality that thrusts itself into attention

defsZh:
n. 降雨, 降雨量
[經] 降雨量

examples.en: We had a heavy rainfall last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚雨勢很大。

examples.en: We have one pocket of rainfall.

defsEn: water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere

defsZh:
n. 再佈置, 變換佈置
[經] 重新安置

examples.en: The couple's relationship slowly began to drift apart after the relocation.

defsEn: the transportation of people (as a family or colony) to a new settlement (as after an upheaval of some kind)

defsZh:
n. 住宅, 居留, 駐紮, 居住期間
[醫] 住房

examples.en: Everyone has the right to freedom of movement and residence within the borders of each State.
examples.zh: 每個人在各國境內均享有遷徙自由與居住自由的權利。

examples.en: In Beijing, hutongs are alleys formed by lines of siheyuans, the traditional courtyard residences.
examples.zh: 在北京，衚衕是由四合院的傳統居所排形成。

defsEn: any address at which you dwell more than temporarily

defsZh:
vt. 取回, 挽回, 彌補, 恢復, 補償, 回憶, 檢索
vi. 找回獵物
n. 取回, 恢復, 救險球
[計] 檢索
defsEn: get or find back; recover the use of

defsZh:
n. 騎手, (檔案後的)附件, 扶手
[化] 遊碼
defsEn: a traveler who actively rides an animal (as a horse or camel)

defsZh:
n. 橡皮, 橡膠, 做摩擦動作的人, 按摩師, 決勝盤
vt. 用橡膠製造, 塗橡膠於

examples.zh: 這不是橡皮。

examples.en: Sorry, I won't do it without a rubber.
examples.zh: 對不起，但是如果不用避孕套的話我不做。

examples.en: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.
examples.zh: 橡皮不硬：它在壓力下會變形。

defsZh: n. 小塊地毯, 揭露某人

examples.zh: 這塊地毯是手工製作的。

examples.en: He never stepped on that rug.
examples.zh: 他從未踩過那塊地毯。

examples.en: When I didn't have any money, I only had a rug for a bed.
examples.zh: 我沒有錢的時候，只能以地毯為床。

defsEn: floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)

defsZh: n. 售貨員,店員

examples.en: Good salespeople are hard to find.
It's hard to find good salespeople.

defsEn: a person employed to represent a business and to sell its merchandise (as to customers in a store or to customers who are visited)
